# Nilasya Agro Foods — Catalogue and export reference

- Brand: Nilasya Agro Foods
- Legal entity: NİLASYA GLOBAL TARIM İTHALAT VE İHRACAT LİMİTED ŞİRKETİ
- Website: https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr

- Primary Loading Hub: Mersin International Port (MIP), Türkiye
- Annual Milling & Supply Capacity: 120,000 MT
- Global Export Reach: 50+ Countries across Europe, Middle East, North Africa, Asia and the Americas
- Email: export@nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr

This reference is generated from the same company, product, country and article data used by the website. For a transaction, request a current quotation and shipment-specific specifications.

## Frequently Asked B2B & Trade Questions

### What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)?
Our standard export minimum order quantity is one 20ft Full Container Load (FCL), which accommodates approximately 24 to 26 Metric Tons (MT) of Sortex-cleaned pulses depending on packaging specifications. Consolidated container loads containing mixed pulses (e.g., chickpeas, red lentils, white beans) are available upon agreement.

### What trade terms (Incoterms) do you support?
We routinely execute contracts under Incoterms 2020: FOB Mersin Port, CFR (Cost and Freight), and CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight) to major international seaports across Europe, the Middle East & Gulf, North Africa, Asia, and the Americas.

### What are the export packaging options?
- Polypropylene (PP) bags: 25 kg and 50 kg multi-wall woven sacks.
- FIBC Jumbo Big Bags: 1,000 kg and 1,200 kg with top spout and discharge bottom.
- Premium Retail Packaging: Nilasya 2.0 kg Stand-up Doypack / Quad-Seal bags packed in master export cartons.
- Private Label (OEM): Custom branding, retail packaging, and carton design are available for supermarket chains and regional distributors.

### What export documentation is provided?
Standard documentation provided with every ocean bill of lading includes: Commercial Invoice, Detailed Packing List, Official Phytosanitary Certificate issued by the Turkish Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, Certificate of Origin (AKİB / Chamber of Commerce), Certificate of Weight and Quality, and independent inspection reports (SGS / Bureau Veritas / Intertek) when requested.

### How do you ensure optical purity and moisture control?
All raw pulses undergo pre-cleaning, mechanical destoning, gravity density grading, and multi-pass Bühler Sortex optical color sorting in Mersin. We guarantee minimum 99.5% optical purity and strictly monitor moisture levels (maximum 12.0% – 14.0%) to prevent heating or degradation during tropical ocean transits.

### What are Türkiye's leading pulse export products and key trade markets?
According to official export statistics from the Mediterranean Exporters Association (AKİB) and the Turkish Ministry of Trade, Red Lentils (Kırmızı Mercimek) represent the highest share (~21%) in Türkiye's total pulse export volume, followed by chickpeas, green lentils, dry white beans, and peas. The #1 export destination market is Iraq (accounting for over $270.6 million and ~22% of total grain and pulse exports from the AKİB region alone), followed by Syria (6%), Egypt (5%), Italy, Sudan, Germany, Algeria, and the USA. Nilasya Agro Foods operates direct processing lines and express transit corridors from Mersin and Southeastern Anatolia to service these high-volume markets with Bühler Sortex purity.

## Turkish Kabuli Chickpeas (Koçbaşı 7mm - 10mm)

Source: https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/chickpeas/

Nilasya Agro Foods supplies calibrated Turkish Kabuli Chickpeas sourced directly from contracted farmers across Central and Southeastern Anatolia. After harvesting under dry sunny conditions, the crop is transported to our Mersin terminal for stone removal, density gravity separation, size grading (7mm, 8mm, 9mm, 10mm), and high-resolution Sortex optical color sorting. Packed in 25kg/50kg PP sacks or 1,000kg Jumbo Big Bags and shipped in 20ft ocean containers (24-26 MT) from Mersin International Port.

Scientific name: Cicer arietinum

- Origin: Türkiye (Konya / Karaman / Mersin)
- Size: 7mm, 8mm, 9mm, 10mm
- Caliber: 8mm, 9mm, 10mm (Koçbaşı Grade 1)
- Purity: min 99.5% (Sortex Cleaned)
- Moisture: max 12.0%
- Protein: 20.5% – 22.0% (dry basis)
- Broken kernels: max 1.0%
- Foreign matter: max 0.1%
- Damaged kernels: max 0.8%
- Shelf life: 24 Months in cool dry storage
- Storage temperature: Ambient (15°C – 22°C), <65% RH
- Storage humidity: 55% – 65% RH

### Varieties

- [Koçbaşı 10mm Jumbo Chickpeas](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/chickpeas/kocbasi-10mm/): Extra large 10mm caliber Turkish Koçbaşı chickpeas. Selected for premium retail packs, gourmet gastronomy, and canning.
- [Koçbaşı 9mm Extra Large Chickpeas](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/chickpeas/kocbasi-9mm/): The international benchmark for Turkish Kabuli chickpeas. Uniform 9mm round caliber, perfect skin integrity.
- [Kabuli 8mm Standard Export Grade](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/chickpeas/kabuli-8mm/): High-volume export grade favored by industrial hummus manufacturers, canning factories, and supermarkets.
- [Split Chickpeas (Chana Dal Grade)](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/chickpeas/split-chickpeas/): Hulled and split chickpeas produced for quick-cooking soups, curries, and industrial food ingredient applications.

### Packaging

- Nilasya 2 KG Premium Retail Stand-up Pouch (Doypack / Quad-Seal): 2.0 kg e Net Weight; 1,200 – 1,400 cartons (approx. 18.0 – 22.0 MT) per 40ft High Cube Container
- Polypropylene (PP) Woven Bag (25 kg & 50 kg): 25.0 kg or 50.0 kg Net; 24.0 – 26.0 Metric Tons per 20ft FCL container
- FIBC Big Bag (1,000 kg Jumbo Bag): 1,000 kg – 1,200 kg Net; 20 to 24 Big Bags per 20ft / 40ft container

## Turkish Red Lentils (Football & Split Sortex)

Source: https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/red-lentils/

Nilasya Agro Foods is a key international exporter of milled and polished Turkish Red Lentils. We operate modern milling lines in Mersin where raw red lentils are de-hulled, calibrated, de-stoned, polished (with or without food-grade oil), and sorted using advanced optical sorters to eliminate all discolored kernels and weed seeds. Available in whole round (Football) and split (Yaprak) grades.

Scientific name: Lens culinaris

- Origin: Türkiye (Gaziantep / Şanlıurfa / Mersin)
- Size: 3.5mm – 4.5mm
- Caliber: Sortex Cleaned 99.8%
- Purity: min 99.8% (Multi-Pass Sortex)
- Moisture: max 12.0%
- Protein: 24.5% – 26.0% (dry basis)
- Broken kernels: max 0.5% (Football), max 1.0% (Split)
- Foreign matter: max 0.1%
- Damaged kernels: max 0.5%
- Shelf life: 24 Months
- Storage temperature: Cool dry warehouse (<20°C, <60% RH)
- Storage humidity: 50% – 60% RH

### Varieties

- [Turkish Red Football Lentils (Whole Hulled)](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/red-lentils/red-football/): De-hulled whole round red lentils. Retains spherical shape during early cooking, ideal for canned soups and stews.
- [Turkish Red Split Lentils (Yaprak Mercimek)](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/red-lentils/red-split/): Hulled and split into two halves. Rapid 15-minute cooking time, velvety consistency for red lentil soups, purees and curries.
- [Oil-Polished Red Split Lentils](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/red-lentils/red-polished/): Lightly polished with food-grade vegetable oil to enhance vibrant luster and provide protection against humidity during ocean shipment.

### Packaging

- Nilasya 2 KG Premium Retail Stand-up Pouch (Doypack / Quad-Seal): 2.0 kg e Net Weight; 1,200 – 1,400 cartons (approx. 18.0 – 22.0 MT) per 40ft High Cube Container

- 1,000 kg Jumbo Big Bags: 1,000 kg Net; 20 – 24 MT per 20ft Container

## Turkish Durum Wheat & Traditional Bulgur

Source: https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/durum-wheat-bulgur/

Our durum wheat is cultivated in the fertile Central and Southeastern Anatolian plains where warm sunny grain-filling periods create high vitreousness (min 85%) and golden amber color. In addition to raw grain, we export parboiled bulgur made exclusively from 100% durum wheat: boiled in stainless steel cauldrons, dried in hygienic solar and hot air tunnels, and milled on stone disks. Available in bulk container liners or 25kg/50kg PP sacks.

Scientific name: Triticum durum

- Origin: Türkiye (Konya / Gaziantep / Mersin)
- Size: Calibrated 2.5mm - 3.2mm grain / Calibrated Bulgur
- Caliber: Grade 1 Amber Durum / Bulgur Grade 1
- Purity: min 99.7%
- Moisture: max 12.5%
- Protein: 13.5% – 15.0% min (dry basis)
- Broken kernels: max 1.0%
- Foreign matter: max 0.1%
- Shelf life: 24 Months
- Storage temperature: Dry ventilated silo or warehouse (<22°C)
- Storage humidity: 50% – 60% RH

### Varieties

- [Amber Durum Wheat Grain (Milling Grade 1)](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/durum-wheat-bulgur/amber-durum-grain/): Hard amber durum wheat with >85% vitreous kernels, high wet gluten, and superior semolina extraction yield.
- [Coarse Pilaf Bulgur (Pilavlık Sarı Bulgur)](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/durum-wheat-bulgur/pilaf-bulgur/): 100% durum wheat, parboiled, dried, and stone-cracked to a coarse calibrated size. High-fiber Mediterranean staple.
- [Fine Meatball Bulgur (Köftelik İnce Bulgur)](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/products/durum-wheat-bulgur/fine-bulgur/): Finely ground parboiled durum wheat. Pre-cooked; swells instantly in hot water without requiring boiling. Ideal for tabbouleh and kibbeh.

## Export markets

Destination routes, documents and Incoterms depend on the shipment and current import requirements. Published transit estimates are subject to carrier schedules and customs clearance.

- [Germany](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/export/germany/): Nilasya Agro Foods supplies German organic wholesalers, food processing plants, and packaging distributors with Sortex-cleaned Turkish chickpeas, red lentils, and white beans shipped in 25kg PP bags, 1,000kg Big Bags, and FCL containers directly from Mersin International Port.
- [United Kingdom](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/export/united-kingdom/): Supplying leading UK ethnic food distributors, canning manufacturers, and supermarket packers across London, Birmingham, and Manchester with high-protein Turkish pulses and durum wheat bulgur.
- [Netherlands](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/export/netherlands/): Supplying Europe’s major agricultural trading hub at the Port of Rotterdam with prime Turkish pulses in 25kg PP bags, 1,000kg Big Bags, and bulk container liners.
- [Russia](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/export/russia/): Direct high-volume pulses and grain supply to Russian federal retail distributors and industrial canneries via Black Sea direct maritime connections and overland corridors.
- [United Arab Emirates (Dubai & Abu Dhabi)](https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr/en/export/united-arab-emirates/): High-volume pulses and grain exports to Dubai Al Ras commodity traders, GCC supermarket chains (LuLu, Carrefour Middle East), and food processing factories across the United Arab Emirates.
